title: Qatar says 14 ballistic missiles and 4 drones intercepted
summary: Fresh waves of explosions, most from interceptions, also rocked Dubai, Doha and Manama on Thursday. Qatar's defence ministry said its forces intercepted 14 Iranian ballistic missiles on Thursday and 4 drones were also shot down, with no casualties reported. Hoda Abdel-Hamid reports from Doha for FRANCE 24;
